title: A service shows no value; the line count opens a hover card
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. A schedule with PM-A (3 canned lines) and PM-C covering PM-A plus 1 line of its own (seed as in the service-table case).
custom_steps:
1. Look anywhere on the service row, the service form and the picker for a price or an estimated time.
  2. Click PM-C's line count "4 lines · 3 covered".
  3. Hover the line count and read the card; then move the pointer away.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • No price and no estimated time appear anywhere; the hours shown are the sum of the lines' hours.
  • Clicking the line count opens nothing (it is not a link).
  • Hovering opens a card styled as a small modal that lists the services it covers (PM-A) and then its canned lines, one per row; it closes when the pointer leaves.
  • On the design the hover card is headed "COVERS" and then "CANNED LINES".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10561 (S4, Attach canned lines to a service), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S4 (What the service is worth; The line count); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), editor service table (line-count hover card); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

  • S4-R5: “Hovering it opens a card styled as a small modal that lists the services it covers and then its canned lines, one per row, and closes when the pointer leaves”
  • Design board, editor service table (line-count hover card): “COVERS”
  • Design board, editor service table (line-count hover card): “CANNED LINES”
